about: What some NPC ants say when the player touches antennae with them, nest by nest (NpcLines.cs, 11-04). A few quiet lines per nest in 中文 and English; the last of each nest's tells where its light leads, the next nest round the ring. The draft the user reviews: Docs/文本/NPC台词_草稿.md. speaker: who is named as speaking. share: about this share of a nest's ants have something to say (the rest only touch antennae back). perAnt: lines one ant says before it only touches back. again: seconds a line just said stays up when the same ant is touched again at once.

nests.name: 0° 古蚁圣殿 · The Ancient Temple

lines.zh: 火走了很久，灰还是温的。
lines.en: The fire is long gone. The ash is still warm.

lines.zh: 神殿是烧剩的树桩，祖先把它一点点咬空。
lines.en: The temple is a burnt stump the ancestors hollowed, bite by bite.

lines.zh: 断面上的一圈圈，是一代代走过的路。
lines.en: The rings in the cut wood are paths walked by generations.

lines.zh: 火后最先长出来的，是红色的小杯子。
lines.en: After the fire, the first to grow were the little red cups.

lines.zh: 在这里，我们像祖先那样碰触角。
lines.en: Here we touch antennae, as the ancestors did.

lines.zh: 灰烬那头，空气里有树脂的味道。
lines.en: Past the ash, the air smells of resin.

nests.name: 30° 暖琥珀蚁穴 · The Amber Nest

lines.zh: 这里的树在流泪，流得很慢。
lines.en: The trees here weep, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我们把树脂搬进巢里，它能挡住病。
lines.en: We carry resin into the nest. It keeps sickness out.

lines.zh: 掉进树脂里的，都会被留住。
lines.en: Whatever falls into the resin is kept.

lines.zh: 琥珀里睡着一只蚂蚁，比这片林子还老。
lines.en: An ant sleeps in the amber, older than this wood.

lines.zh: 松果上的光，是一颗颗没落下的泪。
lines.en: The lights on the great cone are tears that never fell.

lines.zh: 往前走，空气会变甜。
lines.en: Walk on, and the air turns sweet.

nests.name: 60° 蜜罐粮仓 · The Honeypot Granary

lines.zh: 粮仓满了，冬天就不可怕。
lines.en: With the granary full, winter holds no fear.

lines.zh: 有些姐妹一辈子挂在顶上，替大家存着蜜。
lines.en: Some sisters hang from the roof for life, keeping our honey.

lines.zh: 每一粒种子，都是从很远的地方搬回来的。
lines.en: Every seed here was carried from far away.

lines.zh: 那颗大瓜子裂开以后，这里一直是甜的。
lines.en: Since the great seed split open, it has always been sweet here.

lines.zh: 蜜放久了，会变成小小的石头。
lines.en: Kept long enough, honey turns into little stones.

lines.zh: 再往前，叶子都被咬成了月牙。
lines.en: Further on, the leaves are bitten into crescents.

nests.name: 90° 切叶蚁菌圃 · The Leafcutters' Garden

lines.zh: 叶子不是吃的，是用来种菌的。
lines.en: We don't eat the leaves. We grow our garden on them.

lines.zh: 第一位蚁后来的时候，嘴里含着一小块菌圃。
lines.en: The first queen came with a crumb of the garden in her mouth.

lines.zh: 新叶铺在上面，旧叶慢慢变褐。
lines.en: New leaves go on top. The old ones slowly turn brown.

lines.zh: 最小的姐妹坐在叶子上，替我们看着天。
lines.en: The smallest sisters ride on the leaves and watch the sky.

lines.zh: 菌圃发光的时候，是它吃饱了。
lines.en: When the garden glows, it has eaten well.

lines.zh: 前面潮湿，苔藓长得比树还高。
lines.en: Ahead it is damp, and the moss grows taller than trees.

nests.name: 120° 苔藓森林 · The Moss Forest

lines.zh: 对我们来说，苔藓就是森林。
lines.en: To us, the moss is a forest.

lines.zh: 下过雨，整片林子都会醒过来。
lines.en: After rain, the whole forest wakes.

lines.zh: 孢蒴熟了，会张开一圈小牙，等风来。
lines.en: A ripe capsule opens its ring of teeth and waits for wind.

lines.zh: 这里没有谁赶路，苔藓一年只长一点点。
lines.en: Nobody hurries here. The moss grows a little each year.

lines.zh: 戴红帽子的地衣，比这片林子还要老。
lines.en: The red-capped lichen is older than this forest.

lines.zh: 再往前，林子会变蓝，会发光。
lines.en: Further on, the forest turns blue and glows.

nests.name: 180° 蓝色真菌林 · The Blue Fungal Forest

lines.zh: 下面的空气是干净的。
lines.en: Down here, the air is clean.

lines.zh: 菌丝在土里连成一片，整座林子是一体的。
lines.en: Underground the threads join. The whole forest is one.

lines.zh: 发光的不是灯，是它们在呼吸。
lines.en: Those aren't lamps. That's them breathing.

lines.zh: 我们挖过的路，后来变成了你走的路。
lines.en: The tunnels we dug became the paths you walk.

lines.zh: 上面的人留下了一些东西，碰碰它们。
lines.en: The ones above left things here. Touch them.

lines.zh: 灯换了颜色，另一个蚁穴就醒了。
lines.en: When the light changes colour, another nest wakes.

lines.zh: 光的尽头，是一片烧过的林子。
lines.en: At the end of the light lies a burnt wood.
